Title: Verify customer registration form fields and UI layout
Preconditions: User has network access to storefront
Steps: 1. Open browser and navigate to /account/register\n2. Verify presence of First Name, Last Name, Email Address, and Password inputs\n3. Verify presence of 'Create' submit button
Expected Result: Registration form loads with all required inputs visible and accessible
Test Data: URL: https://sauce-demo.myshopify.com/account/register | Fields: first_name, last_name, email, password

Title: Verify client-side HTML5 validation halts submission on malformed email
Steps:
1. Navigate to /account/register
2. Fill First Name and Last Name
3. Fill Email Address with malformed string 'user@invalid'
4. Click 'Create' submit button
5. Inspect input validity state and current URL
Expected Result: HTML5 typeMismatch validation triggers, browser halts submission, and URL remains on /account/register

Title: Verify submitting empty registration form preserves form state on register page
Steps:
1. Navigate to /account/register
2. Leave all fields empty
3. Click 'Create' submit button
4. Verify application behavior and URL
Expected Result: Form is not submitted to /account and user remains on /account/register

Title: Verify bot protection challenge triggers upon customer account registration submission
Steps:
1. Navigate to /account/register
2. Fill valid registration data (First Name, Last Name, unique Email, Password >= 5 chars)
3. Click 'Create' submit button
4. Inspect page frames for security challenge
Expected Result: Registration form activates hCaptcha security challenge (hcaptcha.html iframe) blocking unverified automated bots
Test Data: Data: First Name: QA, Last Name: Test, Email: unique, Password: secret123 | Expected: hCaptcha challenge frame present
